links.outcome: Reproducibility of ChatGPT ABPM interpretations across two rounds three months apart
links.effect: Agreement between rounds was 81% hypertension, 85% nocturnal hypertension, 89% nocturnal dipping, 94% abnormal heart rate; no significant accuracy difference between rounds (all p > 0.05); Kappa 0.63-0.76.
links.quote: The percentage agreement between the first and second round of ChatGPT's analysis was 81% in identifying hypertension, 85% in nocturnal hypertension, 89% in nocturnal dipping, and 94% in abnormal heart rate.

screen.reason: The study tests the baseline diagnostic interpretation accuracy and test-retest reliability of ChatGPT-4 against expert nephrologist consensus using retrospective ABPM clinical records, without evaluating a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
